description: Header file defining a SpinLock class for mutual exclusion with support for cooperative scheduling, thread safety, and profiling hooks. Contains class definitions, inline methods, and internal lock management logic.

classes.name: SpinLock
classes.description: A mutual exclusion lock supporting cooperative scheduling and thread safety, with profiling hooks.

classes.name: SpinLockHolder
classes.description: A RAII helper class that acquires a SpinLock on construction and releases it on destruction.

methods.name: SpinLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock, with options for non-cooperative mode and global static initialization.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Acquire the spinlock, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: TryLock
methods.description: Attempt to acquire the spinlock without blocking; returns true if successful.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Release the spinlock, must be held by the calling thread.

methods.name: IsHeld
methods.description: Check if the lock is currently held.

methods.name: AssertHeld
methods.description: Verify that the current thread holds the lock; crashes if not.

methods.name: EncodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Encode wait cycle count into a lock value.

methods.name: DecodeWaitCycles
methods.description: Decode wait cycle count from a lock value.

methods.name: TryLockImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation of TryLock using compare-and-swap.
